PERQUISITION // BLOC 11, APP. 40, QUAI: HOME SEARCH  //  BLOCK 11, FLAT 40, TANNERS' QUAY
Le domicile déclaré de Teodor VARGA. C'e:
Teodor VARGA's registered address. A woman of about fifty opens the door, a tea towel in her hand.

"Irena BENES. My husband is at the printing works. VARGA? He hasn't lived here for five years. We were given the flat in 1982."

She steps aside to let you in. You have time to search four places.
Les planches sont propres, mais la pouss: The shelves are clean, but the dust has kept the shape of the books that stood there: a whole library, removed at once. At the back, wedged against the wall, one forgotten volume: "The Seasons of Velmira", 1979. Dedication: "For H."
Des épreuves de l'Imprimerie n° 2, corri: Proofs from Printing Works No. 2, corrected in green ink and initialled "K. B.". Underneath, the lease for the flat: Karel BENES, proofreader, tenant since 1 June 1982.
Une enveloppe de la Section 7, ouverte,: An envelope from Section 7, opened, addressed to "T. VARGA" at this address. A summons for 29 October, to "update the identity record". Irena: "Karel went. They said it was a formality. They photographed him."
Des photos de famille des BENES et, à pa: BENES family photos and, set apart, slipped under the cardboard, a photo that is not theirs: a man and a woman on a station platform, "T. and H., 1977". The man has a scar on his right cheek. "We found it when we moved in. I didn't have the heart to throw it away."
Une latte bouge sous votre pied. Dessous: A board moves under your foot. Beneath it, wrapped in newspaper from 1981, handwritten sheets: "November", dated December 1978, crossed out, copied again. The first letters of the lines, in the author's hand: H, A, L, I, N, A. Irena has gone very pale. "Karel found it when he laid the floor. He said it didn't belong to us."
Les chemises de Karel, repassées. Sa ves: Karel's shirts, ironed. His Sunday jacket, the only one. A wedding dress in a cover. You search the pockets one by one under Irena BENES's eyes. There is nothing. She folds everything back behind you.
Sur le palier, Irena BENES vous demande: On the landing, Irena BENES only asks you: "What do I tell Karel tonight?" You do not answer. On the stairs, someone comes down behind you, unhurried.
